reproduced.result: per_scene.csv and histograms bit-identical; summary and freeze candidates equal except pooled std at <= 5e-11 relative (BLAS np.dot summation order); every frozen value unchanged

tau_rule: smallest candidate >= 1.5 x background |D_s - D*| p99 (7.40 mm)
m_lie: M_sensor=0 and |raw D_s - D*| > tau at 1024; never from clamped D_s
ds_clamp_rule: [min D* - 100, max D* + 100] over the sample, rounded outward to 10 mm; margin > 2 tau
ds_clamp_scope: detector D_s input only; before resize/Telea and before any Protocol-B sentinel; flags untouched
ds_clamp_check: cache builder: count scenes where a valid pixel with raw |D_s - D*| <= 2 tau is changed; any on train => cache invalid, widen and rebuild; val/test logged

normalisation.rule: (D - median) / ((p84.13 - p15.87) / 2) on clamped completed train D_s at 224

full_train_check.note: full-train clamp margin below train D* min is 61.7 mm (the 5k-sample rule targeted 100 mm); R4 check passed with 0 truthful pixels clamped on train/val/test_module; this file's sha256 changes with this edit, the cache summaries keep the build-time frozen_sha256
